{{Top|leg}}
'''''Inrider Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of five [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]]. They were launched from an old [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] which was escorting a group of three [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] [[Furlo group|''Furlo'']] carrying munitions intended for [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]], to [[Attack on the Zaarin supply convoy|engage]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|loyalist]] Imperial forces, led by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. However, they along with [[Outrider Squadron]] and the Dreadnaught were destroyed in the battle.
